Package org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc3.tbc.MetaNode.MetaData

Class TestPluginMetaData

java.lang.Object
org.osgi.test.cases.dmt.tc3.tbc.MetaNode.MetaData.TestPluginMetaData
All Implemented Interfaces:
DataPlugin, ExecPlugin, ReadableDataSession, ReadWriteDataSession
public class TestPluginMetaData extends Object implements DataPlugin, ExecPlugin, ReadWriteDataSession
Author:
Andre Assad A test implementation of TestPluginMetaData. This implementation validates the DmtSession calls to a subtree handled by a TestPluginMetaData.
